data.key: Evangelist Boon ~ Gyronna ~ Mother of Curses
data.name: Mother of Curses
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, the rage within your heart shields you against harm and turns it back on others. You gain spell resistance %1, but only against necromancy and transmutation spells, as well as enchantment spells of the charm subschool. Once per day, when a spell fails to penetrate your spell resistance, you can reflect it back on its caster, as if using spell turning.|11+TL
